nodes.statement: First we want to consider the partition function with N_f dynamical quarks, i.e. k=0 . There is no supersymmetry and the whole supermatrix consists of the fermion-fermion block, only, U'=U_ff. For Ntoinfty we have to solve the saddle point equation U'^2=1_2N_f. This implies that all eigenvalues of U' are pm1. When diagonalizing U' to its eigenvalues e^i phi=diag(e^i phi_1,ldots,e^i phi_N_f) we would obtain the Vandermonde term |Delta_N_f(e^i phi)|^2=prod_a<b|e^i phi_b-e^i phi_a|^2 as the Jacobian. This term algebraically suppresses all solutions of~ in 1/N which do not have an equal number of pm1. Thus we integrate only over the coset U(2N_f)/[U(N_f)times U(N_f)] which is the same as for mu=0 (GUE, 3d QCD), see. This coset can be parametrized as U'=Utau_3 U^dagger with UinU(2N_f).

In the large-N limit the saddle point equation~ still applies though with a different dimension in the unit matrix. For this reason we use the parametrization U'_bb& = Le^-vartheta_1tau_3/2e^-vartheta_2tau_2/2tau_1e^z_11_2+z_2 tau_1e^vartheta_2tau_2/2e^vartheta_1tau_3/2,\\ U'_ff& = e^-ivarphi_1tau_3/2e^-ivarphi_2tau_2/2tau_1e^i(z_31_2+z_4 tau_1)e^ivarphi_2tau_2/2e^ivarphi_1tau_3/2, for the two diagonal blocks of U'. The angles take the values z_1,z_2,vartheta_1,vartheta_2inR, varphi_1in[-pi,pi], and varphi_2,z_3,z_4in[-pi/2,pi/2]. From the saddle point equation and the properties of U'_bb and U'_ff we have to expand the variables z_j as follows: (z_1,z_2)=(delta z_1/sqrtN,delta z_2/sqrtN) and (z_3,z_4)=(delta z_3/sqrtN, delta z_4/sqrtN), ~(z_3,z_4)=(pi/2+delta z_3/sqrtN,pi/2+delta z_4/sqrtN). nodes.statement: In we have shown that the spectral statistics describe a Pfaffian point process meaning that all k-point correlation functions as well as averages over ratios of characteristic polynomials of the random matrix D are given by Pfaffian determinants which only comprise three functions.
